# Top Trades Near Me

> Local roofers, driveway companies and plumbers in 312 towns across southern and central England, ranked by their Google rating weighted by review count. 8597 listings, ratings checked 3 Nov 2026. Run by Buildster Digital, Oxford.

How the ranking works: Google star rating (out of 5) multiplied by log10(number of reviews + 1). Firms cannot pay to move up. Sponsored spots are labelled and sit outside the ranked list. Firms with no Google rating are listed after, in no order. Each town page also covers the villages around it.
Disclosure: Buildster Digital is in the same group as Revive Roofing, Revive Plumbing and Revive Driveways, which appear only in labelled sponsored boxes.
Homeowners can ask for free quotes from up to three local firms on any town page.

## Trades

- [Roofers](https://toptradesnearme.co.uk/roofers/): Re-roofs, slipped tiles, flat roofs, leadwork, chimneys, fascias and gutters.
- [Driveway companies](https://toptradesnearme.co.uk/driveways/): Block paving, resin bound, tarmac, gravel, patios and dropped kerbs.
- [Plumbers and heating engineers](https://toptradesnearme.co.uk/plumbers/): Boiler installs and repairs, servicing, leaks, bathrooms, cylinders and landlord gas certificates.
